problem_text: Let a, b, and n be positive integers with both a and b >= 2 and <= 2n. Define an a×b cell loop in a 2n×2n grid to be the 2a+2b-4 cells surrounding an (a-2)×(b-2) rectangle. Find the number of ways to partition a 10×10 grid into 5 cell loops so that every cell belongs to exactly one cell loop.
notes: 83. Catalan: 2*C_5 - 1 = 2*42 - 1 = 83. Casework: 27+2*(14+5+4+5)=83. Both verified. Note: naive geometric sequence 1,3,9,27,... fails; 81 is wrong.
